Data.Recommendedapproach: Approve the draft as-is; it answers the phone/off-network reset and sync questions using the password reset KB. Data.Subject: Password expires while I'm on leave
Data.Body: I got the 14-day password expiry reminder but I'll be on parental leave when it lapses. Can I reset it early from my phone without a company laptop, and will that sync everywhere?
Data.Rationale: The ticket is an Access question about password reset while away, with no current work stoppage, so Low priority. SupportKB confirms resets work off-network from any browser, use a registered mobile verification code, and sync to email, VPN, and HR portal within 5 minutes. The KB does not explicitly say “reset early,” but it documents 14-day expiry reminders and the self-service reset process.
Data.Draftreply:
Hi Tomas,

You can reset your HomeFix network password from your phone without a company laptop. The self-service reset site works from any browser and off the company network.

1. Go to reset.homefixsupply.com from your phone browser.
2. Enter your employee email and select “Send verification code.”
3. Enter the 6-digit code sent to your registered mobile number.
4. Choose a new password with at least 14 characters, including at least one number and one symbol. It cannot match your last 10 passwords.

After the reset, the new password syncs to email, VPN, and the HR portal within 5 minutes.

If you have not registered a mobile number, self-service reset will not work; please call the IT service desk at extension 4357 for identity verification.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
